results.operating_point: builtin-heuristic native verdict (analyze_text); no score threshold
results.method: Independent reproduction: frozen validation cache and final-test cache read directly as JSONL with SHA-256 verification; offset grid re-derived (unshifted strided grid); content-hash disjointness checked by independent direct set intersection; MAGE source_id is the text hash, so content-hash disjointness is source disjointness; detector re-run fresh at its native operating point, twice for determinism; every slice recomputed with Worker A's exact slice definitions, Wilson FPR/TPR from my own formula implementation, bootstrap CIs from a fresh Random(20261116) per call with randrange resampling (Worker A's convention), cluster-bootstrap FPR where k_fp > 0. AUROC point values cross-checked pairwise vs rank; AUPRC cross-checked in the tie-grouped form alongside. No tuning on the final holdout.
